name: Hiring Assist

matched_rules.summary: AI used for recruitment or selection of natural persons — including placing targeted job ads, analysing/filtering applications, and evaluating candidates — is high-risk.

rationale: Classified as high_risk because 1 rule(s) matched. Highest-severity matches: Annex III (4)(a) (high-risk-recruitment).
recommended_controls: Establish a risk management system and data governance for the system
Ensure human oversight of ranking/filtering decisions
Keep logs and technical documentation for conformity assessment
Assess bias and discrimination risks in candidate scoring

technical_controls.summary: Maintain a documented, iterative risk management process for the high-risk hiring system
Human oversight before adverse hiring outcomes; override path active
Automatic logging of hiring AI events for traceability

judgment_calls: high-risk-recruitment: Matching on purpose keywords or job_applicants population is a pragmatic proxy; borderline HR analytics that only aggregate headcount may be over-classified and should be reported via misclassification issues.
disclaimer: This classification is an advisory tool based on a versioned ruleset. It is not legal advice and is not a substitute for qualified counsel or a formal conformity assessment.
